transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because my eating has been all over the place lately. Some days I just forget to eat lunch completely, and then other days I’m standing at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right. It’s just… not like me.
Have you noticed any changes in how you feel about activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Yes. I used to really look forward to things like my watercolor class, quilting circle, and book club. Lately I’ll get my bag ready and leave it by the door, but then I just… don’t go. I can’t seem to make myself care enough, even though I know I used to enjoy them.
How long have you been feeling this way, with changes in eating and loss of interest in activities?

It’s been going on for about a year and five months now. I think it started around when my sister’s health took that serious turn. Since then, I just haven’t felt like myself with eating or going to the things I used to enjoy.
Have you noticed feeling down or depressed most days, even if just a little, for most of the day?
Yes… most mornings I wake up feeling heavy and low, like the day already feels kind of dull before I even get dressed. It tends to stay with me for a good part of the day.
Have you found yourself feeling overly guilty or like you’re not worth much lately, even about things you wouldn’t normally feel that way about?
I don’t think so, not really. I mean, I get disappointed in myself sometimes when I don’t do what I planned, but I wouldn’t say I feel worthless or overly guilty. Not more than usual.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or lacking in energy most days, even if you haven’t done anything physically demanding?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I do get tired sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being most days or happening when I haven’t done anything. It doesn’t stand out to me like that.
Have you noticed that your movements or speech have slowed down, or that you're more restless or fidgety than usual?

Yes, I think so. I feel slowed down lately—like even crossing the room or buttoning my sweater takes longer than it should. But then other times I catch myself pacing around the house, holding the same papers, not really getting anywhere.
Have you found that you don’t take pleasure or interest in anything at all, even things you used to enjoy?

Yes… I think so. I used to look forward to my watercolor class, and the quilting circle, and book club. Now a lot of the time I get the bag ready, set it by the door, and then I just… don’t go. I can’t seem to care enough to make myself do it.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight or sleep patterns lately, like losing or gaining a lot of weight without trying, or sleeping much more or much less than usual?

Yes… my eating has changed more than anything. Some days I just forget to eat lunch altogether, and then other days I’m standing at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though it doesn’t really taste right. It’s not like I’m trying to change my weight or anything.
Can you describe how often the feeling of being heavy or low in the mornings occurs—does it happen nearly every day, or are there significant breaks where you feel more like yourself?

It’s most mornings, I’d say. I wake up and there’s this heavy, low feeling already there, like the day has gone dull before I even get dressed. There might be a better morning here and there, but not many lately.
Have you noticed a significant change in your weight over the past year and a half, like losing or gaining a lot without trying?

I’m not sure about the number on the scale. What I’ve really noticed is my eating being all turned around. Some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’ll just stand at the counter eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
Have you noticed that you've lost or gained a significant amount of weight over the past year and a half without intentionally trying to?

I don’t really know about a big weight change. I haven’t been watching the scale. What I have noticed is my eating is just all turned around—some days I miss lunch without meaning to, and other days I’m snacking on crackers or sweets at the counter, even though nothing tastes very good.
Has there been a period of at least two weeks when you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes. It’s been that way for more than two weeks. Most mornings I wake up with that heavy, low feeling, like the color’s gone out of the day before I even get dressed.
Has your mood felt low or depressed nearly every day, for most of the day, for as long as the past two years?
Yes, it’s been pretty steady. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, low feeling, like the day’s already lost its color before I even get dressed.
Have you noticed that you've lost or gained a significant amount of weight over the past year and a half without intentionally trying to?

I’m still not sure about the weight part. I haven’t really been checking. But like I said, my eating is off—some days I forget lunch altogether, and other days I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets even though nothing tastes right.
